question: In a certain code language, 'CROWNED' is written as 'OWRCEND'. How will 'SERGENT' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter ⇒ Shifted to the fourth position.
 
• Second letter ⇒ Shifted to the third position
 
• Third letter ⇒ Shifted to the first position 
 
• Fourth letter ⇒ Shifted to the second position
 
• Sixth and seventh letter ⇒ Interchanged their positions 
 
• Eighth letter ⇒ No change

So,

 
• 'CROWNED' is written as 'OWRCEND'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e849d011c8f2058fe9c025712ec0f5f1468d161444e9e75aa49f71ea6fe0afb.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'SERGENT' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb59983ab15bae8b1cbd68efef9123f5808201ed3aaede3f2ecd84e911342ea3.png] 

Hence, "**RGESNET**" is the correct answer.
